text:
Marta: Quick design review — proposing a compact, annotated run-history for schema/tool-calls. want feedback on a11y / microcopy. :eyes: Devin: Love the idea. what's the main difference vs current compact view? Marta: Two things: 1) collapse non-tool token lines into a single summary row, 2) surface a short tool-call summary inline with an affordance to expand for full args/response. less vertical noise. Sam: Spacing + hit targets will be critical. compact often makes it hard for keyboard users to find the expand control. Jia: Agreed. Suggestion: keep a 40px min height and make the expand control a real button with aria-expanded and a clear label. Marta: exact microcopy options: "Show details" / "Expand run" / "View call details". My preference: "View call details" (clear for screen readers). thoughts? Devin: "View call details" reads well. For collapsed summary row we should include: tool name, short result type (text/json/image), duration. e.g. "llm.generate · json · 42ms" Luis: For keyboard nav, recommend "Enter/Space to expand" hint in visually-hidden text, and set role=button + tabindex=0 on the summary row. aria-bot: Noted: add live region announcement for expansion. aria-bot: Suggested ARIA snippet: ```html
llm.generate · json · 42ms
...full payload...
Run details expanded
``` Sam: Two nits: 1) don't rely on aria-hidden toggles alone for show/hide; update aria-expanded and remove hidden when expanded. 2) make the live text include the tool name: "Run details expanded for llm.generate" Jia: Accessibility aside, UX question: do we show token-level cost inline? My worry: cost makes compact rows noisy. Proposal: show "est cost: $0.00" only when expanded, and have a tiny cost-icon in the summary for quick glance (aria-label with exact amount). Marta: 👍 on hiding exact cost by default. let's keep a tiny currency glyph so product can scan for costy runs. Devin: What about copy when expansion fails (chunked load)? Example microcopy: "Loading call details…" and if error: "Failed to load details. Retry" button. Keep concise. Marta: Also adding an inline diff affordance for reordered schema changes — show a little "schema changed" pill if the response has a different output schema than previous run. helps catch regressions. Luis: For that pill, use color + an icon, but ensure text "schema changed" is available to SRs. maybe aria-label="Schema changed compared to previous run". Sam: Small CSS/contrast nit: the pill bg in mock is 3:1 vs body text. need 4.5:1. Jia: Dev question: how do we surface function definitions collapse? Do we inline the short signature in summary? Marta: plan: summary includes function name + compact sig like "translate(text: string) → string" truncated after 40 chars with title for full. Expand shows full fn defs with examples. Devin: One more: add a per-run keyboard shortcut hint: "Press K to open run quick actions" — but only reveal in help overlay, not in-line. Marta: Action items: - Sam: prototype keyboard focus states + aria-expanded behavior (due EOD Wed) - Devin: finalize microcopy options and loading/error strings (EOD Tue) - Jia: a11y review checklist for dev handoff (focus order, live region content, contrast) (Thu) - Luis: design the schema-change pill with contrast tokens and accessible tooltip (Thu) - Marta: integrate into playground mock and run a quick usability 5-min test tomorrow morning. Devin: Sounds good. I'll drop a small Figma frame and add the microcopy variants. :thumbsup: Marta: Thanks team. Quick ask — can someone add a short screenshot of the current compact run to the thread so I can annotate? Sam: Dropping one in #design-assets now. Marta: perfect. closing loop later with prototype link. :rocket:
